title: Write SOPs from a screen recording or rough notes
summary: Paste a transcript or messy notes and get a numbered SOP with purpose, steps, finish checks, and escalation points. You fill gaps before you hand it to a new hire.

tests.prompt:
Turn this rough process description into a clear SOP someone new could follow.

Source material: [PASTE TRANSCRIPT, SCREEN-RECORDING NOTES, OR BULLETS]
Process name: [NAME]
Audience: [WHO WILL FOLLOW THIS — e.g. new hire, contractor]
Tools they have access to: [LIST]
Known exceptions: [LIST OR "none"]

Output:
# [Process name]
## Purpose (1–2 sentences)
## When to use
## Steps (numbered, action verbs, one action per step)
## Checks before you finish
## Escalation / when to ask a human

Rules:
- 5–15 steps unless the source is longer; group with short headings
- Active voice. No fluff intro.
- Do not invent tools, logins, or policy. Mark gaps as [NEED INPUT: …].

setup.agent: Any chat model; optional transcription tool before the prompt
steps: Record yourself doing the task once, or dump rough bullets.
Transcribe if needed, then paste into the prompt with audience and tools.
Run the prompt and walk through each step yourself.
Replace every [NEED INPUT] with real detail.
Store the SOP where the team will actually open it.
setup.approvalStep: A person who did not write it must complete the task from the SOP before you call it done.
failureModes: Skipping error cases that happen weekly
Inventing button names or menu paths

toolPicks.why: Trigger from a new doc in your SOP folder to request a rewrite.
Same automation with less hosting work.
Send transcripts from a recorder into a draft doc.

faq.q: What if my notes are really messy?
faq.a: Still run it, then fix [NEED INPUT] markers. Cleaner source material always wins.
This prompt is text-only. Add images yourself after the steps are right.
